commit_message: Fix GGUF parser lint and seed visual candidate
pr_title: GameEngine: derive managed GGUF representation from file contents
pr_body:
## Summary

- derive Managed Local GGUF representation from file metadata and tensor descriptors rather than filename markers
- preserve an exact path-independent descriptor for mixed/custom representations and require it for managed Benchmark Campaign candidates
- keep legacy registry JSON readable while requiring one re-registration before old filename-derived entries become benchmark eligible
- fix the GGUF parser Clippy failure and remove avoidable test allocations
- seed a feature-gated `3.69bpw` GGUF visual fixture so the managed campaign candidate and exact representation can be inspected

## Scope

Managed Local AI GGUF registration and ADR 0156 Benchmark Campaign representation identity only.
